data.rationale: The proposal gets the same procedure in the right order (Careers, Openings, Country, Team, Time Type filters, search, open job, apply), but it misses the "action" parameter (open vs save) and swaps in a vague "job_title" parameter, so a builder would have to guess which job to open and what to do with it.
